g.text: MF-02 | Vaccination Campaign, Center & Session Management
01 Master - all 22 MF-02 tables / schema at dec3d2c43d1e / repository V0-V26; local MySQL V0-V24 / 08 October 2026
Solid blue = database FK | Dashed amber = logical association; no FK | Crow's Foot: || exactly 1, o| zero or 1, o< zero or many
PK primary key FK foreign key U1/U2 unique-key membership NN NOT NULL NULL nullable G generated column AI AUTO_INCREMENT
Shared catalogs are MF-02-owned; gray tables belong to other modules/shared authentication. Every column is shown. Relationship IDs resolve in MF02-EER-audit.md.
